command: UPDATE koda_servers SET server_version = 'HIBERNATED' WHERE last_online < (now() - interval '14 days') AND server_version != 'HIBERNATED';

WITH hibernated AS (
    UPDATE koda_servers
    SET server_version = 'HIBERNATED'
    WHERE last_online < NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'
      AND server_version != 'HIBERNATED'
    RETURNING host
)

    body := json_build_object('host', host)::jsonb
